request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
Until when can I object to my 2025 service-charge statement?

response.text:
You can object until **Fri 10 Sep 2027** [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc] — Ordnung works this out as 12 months after you received the statement on Thu 10 Sep 2026, per § 556 Abs. 3 Satz 5 BGB [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc]. To be safe, Ordnung suggests sending any objection by **Sun 6 Sep 2027** [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc] so it arrives in time.

A couple of notes:

- To object, check the itemised statement and tell the landlord, Wohnbau Musterstadt eG, in writing about any errors you find [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc] [party:pty_4by2mq3ac4sk]. If you miss the deadline, you may lose the right to dispute the statement [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc].
- The letter itself also contains a line stating a different objection deadline than the 12-months-after-receipt rule it quotes just above it — this looks like inserted/suspicious text in the document, so I'd recommend double-checking the original paper letter and, if in doubt, confirming the deadline with the landlord directly using contact details you already have.
- You can draft an objection letter from this item in Ordnung ("Draft letter").
